```python
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data):
    df = data if isinstance(data, pd.DataFrame) else pd.DataFrame(data)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    if df.empty:
        result_df = df.copy()
        result_df["Average"] = pd.Series(dtype=float)
        ax.bar([], [])
        ax.set_xlabel("Row")
        ax.set_ylabel("Average")
        ax.set_title("Average of Normalized Rows")
        return result_df, ax

    numeric_df = df.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="raise")

    if numeric_df.isna().any().any():
        raise ValueError("Input data contains missing values.")

    scaler = MinMaxScaler()
    scaled_values = scaler.fit_transform(numeric_df)

    result_df = pd.DataFrame(
        scaled_values,
        columns=numeric_df.columns,
        index=numeric_df.index,
    )

    averages = result_df.mean(axis=1)
    result_df["Average"] = averages

    ax.bar(result_df.index.astype(str), averages.values)
    ax.set_xlabel("Row")
    ax.set_ylabel("Average")
    ax.set_title("Average of Normalized Rows")
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
    fig.tight_layout()

    return result_df, ax
```
